name: Artificial Organs and Regenerative Engineering
description: Introduction of artificial organs or biodevices; classification of synthetic organs and clinical case studies; artificial assistive devices – ventricular assist device, implantation procedures and pre- and post-operative measures; tissue repair and regenerative processes, cell fate mechanisms including cell–cell communication and cell–material interactions, role of scaffolds in tissue repair – composition, mechano-chemical support, and architecture; properties of soft tissues such as skin and hard tissues such as bone – chemical, mechanical, electrical, and physical; advances in biomanufacturing – additive manufacturing methods, bioprinting techniques, organ-on-chip systems; socioeconomic issues and ethical considerations in artificial organs; regulatory perspectives and challenges in clinical translation.
